**Finding submitted: deviation (medium) — Section 13, ¶p0047**

**What the clause does:** Section 13 imposes a mutual non-solicit that binds Clear Capital as well as RadialSpark. It is largely within our accepted fallback:

- ✅ Mutual, not one-way
- ✅ Scoped to personnel "who have had direct involvement with the Services" — not all Vendor personnel
- ✅ Duration is term + one year, well inside the 24-month walk-away line
- ✅ Solicitation-only — no no-hire provision (hiring absent solicitation is not prohibited)

**Why it still fails the fallback:** There is no carve-out for general advertising / untargeted recruiting or for unsolicited approaches by personnel. The rule requires a general-advertising carve-out as a material element of any acceptable non-solicit, and without it routine job postings or an inbound application from a RadialSpark consultant could put Clear Capital in breach.

**Redline (validated, ok:true):** A single appended sentence to ¶p0047 preserving duration, scope and the consent mechanic:

> This Section shall not restrict either party from (a) placing general advertisements or conducting other recruiting efforts not specifically targeted at the other party's personnel, or hiring any person who responds thereto, or (b) hiring any person who approaches such party on an unsolicited basis.

Drafted at the **fallback** level, consistent with precedent `seed-nosolicit` (Harbor Consulting SOW). Pressing for the preferred position (no non-solicit at all) would be disproportionate here given the clause is already mutual and narrowly scoped.
